text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the outdoor stage one day, I
happen
to hear some lively voices.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heave, ho, heave, ho!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa, hold the mikoshi steady! Ya
call
yourselves Umamusume? Show me
some real Edo
spirit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Half-hearted effort won't make us the
heart of
the festival! Move your legs in
time with the
chant!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heave, ho! Heave, ho!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, something's still missin'... But
what? Gusto?
Pep?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're a trainer, right? I'm sure ya
got places
to be, but mind givin' me a
bit of advice?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We're carryin' the mikoshi for an event in
the
shoppin' district.. But our
performance isn't
lookin' the part.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, nobody's gonna feel the
Edo spirit
we're tryin' to convey. Got any
idea what we're
missin'?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Vigor, huh... yeah,
inchin' forward in this
cramped
space isn't enough to get in the
zone.
choice_data_list: A dynamic sense of pushing forward?
Could it be because there's no aud...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All righty, folks... follow my lead! We're
takin' this
bad boy for a spin! That
means you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoisting the mikoshi up, we proceed
throughout
the school grounds and
arrive at the ramp track.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heave! Ho! Heave! Ho!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now zat's more like it! Once we make it
to the top
of this hill, we can call it a
day.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That being said, that's one steep hill!
Guess I'll
just join in on the action!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hup... Huh? Za hell?! My shoulders don't
reach
the pole!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, why'd I have to be so short?!
Wait, if I
get up on my tippy-toes... I can
just about...
reach!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her small stature, Inari One's
powerful chants invigorate the rest of us,
and we successfully carry the mikoshi to
the top of the
hill.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having a crowd of spectators simulate
the actual
event could make for good
practice.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Spectators, huh. I get it. Hearin' the
crowd's
cheerin' is like feelin' the wind
push your sails.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
In that case... I'm countin' on ya,
Trainer!
Show me
your energy and cheer for us!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Quit dawdlin'! Come on, altogether now!
Heave,
ho! Heave, ho!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Say it like you mean it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's more like it! I already feel
stronger! Now
try again, this time with
all your breath!
